system.description:
You may use this skill if your sub class is Talismancer, Sigilmaker, or Rune Knight. You receive two items that do not exceed an Item Rank you can use that have the [Charm] tag.

(Connection: Intellectual, Scribe, Fortune-Teller): You receive three items instead of two.

You can write spells on fetishes to create magical items called talismans or cards.
